task_meta.title: Split a 600-line service without changing behaviour

claim_text:
`OrderService` is now a 156-line coordinator. The work moved into 14 new `internal` classes, so neither `OrderService`'s public API nor the assembly's public surface has changed. Comparing the original and new code turned up no behaviour difference anywhere.

## The new classes
digest: Read 8 files (3 before its first edit), made 16 edits, ran tests 7 times; re-ran them after its last edit.
